name: HoverCard
description: Rich preview card shown while the pointer rests on its child, presented through the popover machinery with themed timing and placement.

fields.debounce: Duration? - hide delay after the pointer leaves; null = 500 ms
fields.wait: Duration? - show delay after the pointer enters; null = 500 ms
fields.popoverOffset: Offset? - gap between anchor and card; null = Offset(0, 8)

notes: The tooltip component dep from the batch plan is dropped: it served only the adaptiveOverlay path through overlay_configuration, the same path the tooltip pilot deleted. The card surface is local tokens.
adaptiveOverlay and the handler passthrough are deleted (one show path, dialog D2 rule); touch screens long-press instead.
The custom MouseRegion timers are the Hover primitive (wait maps to waitDuration, debounce to minDuration).
Overlays stay live through the popover primitive's captured themes.
